## Selected work

- NIM Production: Industrial production-management and real-time traceability platform. Stack includes Next.js, React, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Socket.IO, and Docker. Case study: https://www.ahmedkhlif.dev/projects/nim-production
- TDG Management Platform: Full-stack management platform developed during a PFE internship.
- SalesLens BI: Sales analytics and BI dashboard built with SQL Server, SSAS, NestJS, and Next.js.
- Invited+: Event-management platform with task management, collaboration, access control, and analytics.
- Student Q&A Assistant: NLP assistant for student administrative questions, built with Python, Flask, React, and classical NLP.
- FabLab Tap Card Profiles: NFC-based profile sharing and contactless portfolio experience.
